label: Kenshi sandboxes
description: How Kenshi sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: vortex.

notes: Each mod is a folder under mods whose .mod file carries the same name. Kenshi reads the enabled list from data/mods.cfg, which this app does not write; enable the mod in the launcher once. The Steam build is kenshi_x64.exe and the GOG build kenshi_GOG_x64.exe.
Hard links are the default: the game folder and the staging folder are almost always on one drive, and nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod.
